• Are you passionate about contemporary design and bringing innovative lighting products to life?

• Do you have a technical background and experience developing products from concept to production?

• Would you like to join a creative and international team in the heart of Copenhagen?

If yes, please read on!

PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

At our office in the heart of Copenhagen, you will join our Lighting Product Development team, working closely with talented designers, colleagues across different functions and international manufacturing partners. You will play a key role in transforming creative ideas into high-quality lighting products that combine design, functionality and technical excellence.

About the job

As Product Developer – Lighting at HAY, you will be involved in developing decorative LED lighting products from initial concept to final production. Combining technical development skills with a strong understanding of design, you will work closely with designers, internal teams and international manufacturing partners to bring creative ideas to life.

An important part of your role will be to maintain the original design intent throughout the development process, while ensuring that products meet technical requirements and can be manufactured efficiently. You will help drive projects forward, balancing design, functionality, quality, cost and timelines.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Manage product development projects from initial concept to production, ensuring timelines and key deliverables are met.

• Develop decorative LED lighting solutions, including optics, thermal management, drivers and dimming technologies.

• Create detailed, production-ready 3D models, assemblies and technical drawings using SolidWorks.

• Translate design concepts into technically feasible products, developing and testing prototypes and resolving technical and manufacturing challenges.

• Prepare technical specifications, bills of materials (BOMs) and test documentation.

• Ensure compliance with relevant electrical, safety, sustainability and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with designers, internal teams and external manufacturing partners throughout the development process.

• Manage project timelines, costs and technical deliverables, supporting suppliers with tooling, pilot production and quality control.

• Format 2D documentation utilizing Microsoft and Adobe Creative Suite packages.

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your projects, keeping track of timelines and collaborating with colleagues and external partners to find the best solutions.

Role expectations

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

• You enjoy collaborating with designers, colleagues and external partners.

• You are a team player who values collaboration and contributes positively to the HAY culture.

Experience required

• You have a relevant educational background in Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience in technical product development, ideally taking products from concept to production. Experience within decorative lighting is an advantage.

• You have technical knowledge of LED lighting and an understanding of relevant electrical, safety and regulatory requirements.

• You are proficient in SolidWorks, including 3D modeling, assemblies and technical drawings.

• You have experience with prototyping, testing and technical documentation, along with an understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and supplier collaboration.

• You are familiar with Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite for preparing and formatting product documentation.

• You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken, as we are an international company.

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV, along with a portfolio showcasing relevant product development projects, as soon as possible and no later than Wednesday 18 November. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com or Senior Manager, Sam Weller at sam.weller@hay.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

We’re looking for a Commercial Enablement Manager to drive commercial readiness and effectiveness across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and our partner network. Using data, customer insight and market intelligence, you’ll shape our enablement strategy to strengthen our value proposition, focus on the right opportunities and drive measurable revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you’ll join our newly established Revenue Operations & Commercial Strategy team, alongside Business Intelligence, Marketing Automation & AI, and Product Marketing. Together, we own the commercial revenue engine across Sales and Marketing.

Your focus will be turning insight into action to improve pipeline, conversion, retention and cross-sell. You’ll play a key role in our 2027 priorities, including ABM in priority sectors, growth in DACH and the Nordics, partnerships and portfolio cross-sell.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As our Commercial Enablement Manager, you’ll own the commercial enablement strategy and execution, roadmap and performance across Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. Through combining strategic direction with data-driven decision-making, you’ll equip our teams and partners to turn commercial opportunities into results.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Align programmes, content and priorities with commercial objectives, product strategy and brand positioning across all three brands.

• Partner with BI and RevOps to analyse CRM, pipeline, win/loss, sales conversation and customer data, identify performance gaps and measure revenue impact.

• Develop account- and sector-specific playbooks, messaging, competitive positioning, objection handling and customer proof points across the buying and renewal journey.

• Lead our commercial events strategy by setting objectives and target-account strategies for conferences, executive events and partner events, and measuring their impact on pipeline and customer relationships in collaboration with our events agency.

• Turn insights from Sales, CS, customers and partners into actionable improvements for Marketing, Product and RevOps.

• Own partner enablement by shaping partner onboarding, certification, train-the-trainer programmes, co-branded resources and sector initiatives that help agency and reseller partners sell our portfolio independently.

• Support launches, new propositions and priority segments, measuring adoption, knowledge and field effectiveness to continuously improve enablement.

• Equip customer-facing teams and partners to communicate our value in marketing analytics, privacy-first data and compliance.

**About You

**You’re a strategic, data-driven commercial thinker who turns customer insight and business performance into practical action. You understand that effective enablement is about driving measurable improvements, not simply producing more content or training. You’re comfortable setting direction, influencing stakeholders and owning outcomes, while staying close to what customer-facing teams need to succeed.

You bring:

• A commercial and data-driven mindset where you use data to set priorities, identify performance gaps and demonstrate the business impact of your work.

• Customer-centricity with the ability to turn feedback from Sales, Customer Success, customers and partners into improvements in messaging, processes and commercial effectiveness.

• Events expertise through your experiences shaping conferences, executive events or partner events around clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes.

• Stakeholder leadership through cross-functional team alignment, influence without direct authority and coordination of internal stakeholders and external agencies towards shared goals.

• The ability to simplify complex topics, communicate a compelling value proposition and lead effective presentations and train-the-trainer programmes.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Piwik PRO or other web analytics platforms, such as GA4, Adobe Analytics or Matomo.

• Knowledge of GDPR/ePrivacy, consent management and data governance, or experience selling into regulated sectors such as healthcare, finance, energy and the public sector.

• Experience enabling agency partners in regulated markets, including US healthcare.

• Experience supporting multi-brand portfolios, cross-sell motions and commercial teams across European markets.

• Familiarity with enablement platforms such as Highspot, Seismic or Showpad, and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong.

• Knowledge of German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• A compelling product and market opportunity helping us turn growing demand for privacy-first analytics and trusted data solutions into commercial growth.

• Ownership and impact potential where you can come and build our enablement strategy and shape how we sell across three brands and multiple European markets.

• Strategic breadth by connecting data-driven ABM, sector strategy, partner development, customer engagement and high-impact events.

• A voice in the business working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing and RevOps to influence how we go to market.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team (online)

• A final interview with the hiring manager, including a live case (online)

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

**The Role

**The Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning is responsible for coordinating end-to-end supply planning and execution for assigned products across Genmab’s global commercial supply chains, ensuring reliable and compliant product supply to markets.

Working closely with CMOs and internal cross-functional stakeholders, the Manager maintains up-to-date supply plans and coordinates operational planning and execution processes. The role ensures transparency of batch status, supply priorities, responsibilities, and risks, with timely follow-up and escalation to support supply continuity in a global, GxP-regulated environment. The role also collaborates with Clinical Supply to support alignment across commercial and clinical supply needs.

You will be joining the Corporate Supply Chain Planning team, reporting to the Senior Director. The team is responsible for Genmab’s global supply chain planning activities and supports Genmab’s mission to transform patient lives through innovative antibody medicines.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning you will be responsible for planning and executing supply chain activities across commercial programs, for an assigned product/product group or supply chain, ensuring alignment between demand, manufacturing, and distribution.

• Oversee daily supply chain operations, including order management, replenishment, inventory planning, and supply planning across international markets

• Coordinate operational planning and execution processes across Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Life Cycle Management, Logistics, and CMOs for assigned products, ensuring supply plans remain up to date and that batch status, priorities, responsibilities, and risks are transparent across functions

• Act as key interface with CMOs to align on production schedules, execution, and supply priorities

• Serve as key user of ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), supporting planning, execution, and data integrity

• Identify, assess, and mitigate supply and capacity risks, developing contingency plans that strengthen business resilience and protect patient supply

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities through proper documentation and process adherence

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, new product introductions, CMC project activities, and process standardization efforts that improve planning maturity, execution reliability, and scalability

• Contribute to the S&OP process for assigned products through supply planning inputs, risk assessments, and scenario evaluations
